hook: 主庫差集 J 專場：J彈跳床——把還沒進幽默庫的詞請上台對號入座。
script: jabber／jaded／jargon／jaunty／jejune／jingoism 先登台。其餘同字母 orphan 接龍站位。導播：這不是字典朗讀，是差集清剿晚會；每個詞帶一個角色名牌以免走失。

members.senseAnchor: rapid and indistinct speech; talk in a noisy, excited, or declamatory manner
members.speakLineEn: Cue the J席-快而不清: jabber walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「J席-快而不清」出場：jabber 一上場梗就黏住——快而不清楚的說。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the J席-adj.: jaded walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「J席-adj.」出場：jaded 一上場梗就黏住——adj. 厭倦的。

related.synonyms: tire, pall, weary, fatigue, jade, wear

members.senseAnchor: a characteristic language of a particular group (as among thieves); a colorless (or pale yellow or smoky) variety of zircon
members.speakLineEn: Cue the J席-術語；行: jargon walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「J席-術語；行」出場：jargon 一上場梗就黏住——術語；行話。

related.synonyms: slang, cant, lingo, argot, patois, vernacular

members.senseAnchor: marked by up-to-dateness in dress and manners; having a cheerful, lively, and self-confident air; - Frances G. Patton; - H.M.Reynolds
members.speakLineEn: Cue the J席-快樂的: jaunty walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「J席-快樂的」出場：jaunty 一上場梗就黏住——快樂的。

related.synonyms: dapper, dashing, natty, raffish, rakish, spiffy

members.speakLineEn: Cue the J席-adj.: jejune walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「J席-adj.」出場：jejune 一上場梗就黏住——adj. 無聊的。

related.antonyms: bright, lively, sharp, sharpen, stimulating, flavorful, exciting

members.senseAnchor: an appeal intended to arouse patriotic emotions; fanatical patriotism
members.speakLineEn: Cue the J席-侵略主義: jingoism walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「J席-侵略主義」出場：jingoism 一上場梗就黏住——侵略主義。

members.senseAnchor: full of or showing high-spirited merriment; ; - Wordsworth

members.speakLineZh: 請「J席-快活的；」出場：jocund 一上場梗就黏住——快活的；高興的。

members.senseAnchor: move or cause to move with a sudden jerky motion; disturb (someone's) composure

members.speakLineZh: 請「J席-令人震驚」出場：jolting 一上場梗就黏住——令人震驚的。
